headline: HP, Asus, Acer Quietly Embrace Limited CXMT Chips Amid Tight DRAM Supply, as They Fear Upsetting Memory Giants: Report
summary: HP, Asus and Acer adopt CXMT memory chips amid shortages while trying not to upset major suppliers like Micron and Samsung.
